text:
Alex: heads-up — ticket from Jamie (CS): p95 for tenant acme-inc jumped to ~820ms after last-night runtime rollout.
Mira: what's the scope? routes, time window?
Alex: CS snippet: spikes on /v1/generate and /v1/chat; mostly long-context messages; started right after deploy (~00:45 UTC).
Jamie (CS): customer sees client timeouts at 1s. they're on Dedicated us-west pinned to runtime v2026-03-16.
deploy-bot: rollout complete for runtime v2026-03-16 -> 100% traffic at 00:43:12 UTC. Canary green.
Li: note: a scheduler tweak landed in that runtime: batch_window_ms 20->40 to boost throughput; could increase p95 for small, latency-sensitive requests.
Sandeep: that could explain added queuing. But why auth-related long hangs?
Mira: telemetry shows ~30% of requests in a slow cohort: KV-cache miss + auth-refresh triggered synchronous KMS call; these requests have larger sequence lengths.
Alex: any traces?
Li: sample trace for acme-inc: ```span:gen-12345 start=1718500123 end=1718500123.820
  runtime:kernel-select -> 4ms
  kv-cache:miss -> 6ms
  auth-refresh -> 650ms (wait on KMS)
  model-infer -> 120ms
  total -> 820ms
```
Li: auth-refresh is the big contributor.
Sandeep: why a sync KMS hit? we support async refresh path. Could a config change have lowered token refresh threshold?
Mira: checked rollout diff — token-refresh-threshold lowered 60s->10s in the same PR (to reduce stale tokens). This would cause earlier refresh during long requests.
Alex: so combined: larger batch window + earlier sync auth refresh => more requests hit KMS slow path => p95 increase. aligns with data.
Jamie (CS): customer requests immediate mitigation — either restore latency or route them to previous runtime.
Li: mitigation options: rollback fleet, revert token-threshold hotfix, increase KMS throughput or async fallback, or route tenant to previous runtime.
Sandeep: tenant routing override is fastest for a Dedicated tenant. We can pin acme-inc to v2026-03-15 in ~5-10m.
Mira: I can craft the routing traffic rule: acme-inc -> v2026-03-15. Need infra signoff.
deploy-bot: A/B traffic routing update request received: change tenant routing for acme-inc -> runtime v2026-03-15.
oncall-bot: oncall incident created INC-2026-17185 (latency regression after runtime rollout) — P2.
Alex: Jamie, inform customer we'll route them back and monitor; ask them to confirm if errors persist.
Jamie (CS): messaging them now, will post back.
Mira: while routing, revert token threshold in mainline and add a CI test for near-expiry tokens. Also add telemetry to flag auth-refresh-triggering requests.
Li: opening quick PR to revert threshold + CI test. PR af34b9 (WIP).
Sandeep: I'll add telemetry to flag these requests and a dashboard tile for cohorts.
Li: routing change applied at 00:56:10 UTC. Observability: acme-inc p95 dropped to ~130ms in ~2 minutes.
Jamie (CS): customer confirms latency normalized and timeouts cleared. :tada: 
Alex: deploy team — prepare rollback playbook if more tenants impacted, but wait until revert patch lands.
Mira: postmortem TODO: explain why canary didn't capture auth-refresh path; add prompt-length/token-expiry variants to canaries.
Li: will merge revert after CI green and cut patch runtime. ETA ~2h.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: INC-2026-17185 — acme-inc routed back to v2026-03-15; regression isolated to cohort with token-refresh + batch window. Ongoing: patch build + telemetry.
Alex: great work. keep updates concise here; escalate if impact broadens.
Jamie (CS): customer asked for an email summary after RC. I'll draft.
Alex: thanks all — closing thread when follow-ups are tracked.
